name: messaging.delete-draft
description: Delete a cloud draft. This permanently changes the signed-in account's draft state; native acknowledgement is not readback proof.

name: messaging.create-text-draft
description: Create a non-empty plain-text cloud draft in a native chat. This changes signed-in draft state; native acknowledgement is not readback proof.

parameters.name: chatId
parameters.description: Native desktop chat identifier, not a public oc_ alias.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Plain text, non-empty after trimming, at most 16 KiB UTF-8.

name: messaging.set-chat-last-read
description: Change the signed-in account's read position for a chat; native acknowledgement is not readback proof.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: Message position; the UI defaults to -1.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Offset rounded and sent as a string; the UI defaults to 0.
